name: Ashwagandha

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A standardised root extract of Withania somnifera taken for stress and sleep. It is a recognised cause of herb-induced liver injury with a characteristic cholestatic pattern, and has documented effects on thyroid hormone levels.

systems.note: Taken for stress, anxiety and sleep effect; the intended effect.
A documented cause of herb-induced liver injury with a cholestatic pattern.
Raises thyroid hormone levels and has precipitated thyrotoxicosis in case reports.
Reported testosterone effects are small and inconsistent but will move the reading.

monitors.why: Documented cholestatic herb-induced liver injury; the specific concern for this botanical.
Confirms a raised alkaline phosphatase is hepatobiliary, which is the reported injury pattern.
The reported injury pattern is cholestatic.
Documented thyroid hormone elevation and case reports of thyrotoxicosis.
Separates a botanical-driven hormone rise from underlying autoimmune thyroid disease.
Read with TSH for the documented thyroid effect.
